traces.name: Destination research to actual capability means

prerequisite.claim: With Agriculture already researched, Mining -> Bronze Working -> Iron Working; all predecessors required and unavailable paths rejected.

decision.claim: Pick Iron Working as destination; picker expands missing prerequisites into one retained queue, replaces or appends it at player choice.

cost_time.claim: Three technologies have 265 total base science (35+55+175), before difficulty/speed/map/city/known-civ/unique modifiers. Selection does not debit gold. Queue head consumes available science each end turn; other research destinations wait. Negative treasury plus negative gold yield reduces science.

mutation.claim: Completion adds researched tech, removes nonrepeatable head and in-progress entry, retains capped overflow, refreshes resource info and reveals explored Iron.

consumer.claim: Swordsman gate requires researched Iron Working AND available one Iron capacity; 75 base production is separately accumulated and adjusted. Successful completion calls actual unit construction. Research reveals availability but grants neither iron stock nor unit.

failure_aftermath.claim: Missing tech/iron yields concrete build rejection; construction rechecks remove unsupported queued work. Enough production without placement space returns false and notifies; researched technology stays retained. Placement failure is not mutation-free: constructIfEnough increments builtItemsWithIncreasingCost after the success/failure branch. No universal refund/zero-mutation guarantee is inferred.

traces.name: Paid exclusive policy with conditional future science

prerequisite.claim: Rationalism requires Renaissance era, policy predecessors, no previously adopted Piety and culture budget or a free-policy entitlement; normal UI checks every gate.

decision.claim: Adopt Rationalism through confirmed picker; Piety and Rationalism exclude each other on normal adoption path.

cost_time.claim: Culture earned on end turns is stored. Adoption spends current increasing/multiplied culture cost and raises paid-policy count, or consumes one free policy. Spending culture delays another policy and Piety branch becomes unavailable.

mutation.claim: Adopted policy ID is retained and its unique enters policyUniques; city stats refresh.

consumer.claim: Rationalism adds +15% Science only when happiness >=0; city percent bonuses multiply final science, aggregate into next-turn output, and feed actual technology progress.

failure_aftermath.claim: Piety already adopted blocks Rationalism; not enough culture prevents pick/adoption. If happiness becomes negative, the multiplier fails its conditional while adopted ID/foregone branch remain. This is no promised universal permanent science bonus.

map.mechanism: City science and treasury pressure are distinct. Negative gold rate and negative treasury reduce effective science; queue costs are science and waiting, not an invented gold payment. At deep upkeep shortfall (-200 gold and negative flow), endTurn disbands real military units and recomputes stats.
map.yairpg_implication: A paid field study should reserve actual actor/site inputs before work; do not treat wealth as automatic knowledge or create a duplicate abstract science owner.

map.system_join: research eligibility -> reveal -> physical means -> production -> placement
map.mechanism: All technology prerequisites, conditional availability, actual known Iron, available Iron capacity, production investment and tile placement remain separate gates. A technology reward grants neither materials nor unit. Unsupported queued construction is revalidated; placement failure gives notification instead of a fabricated unit. Placement failure is not mutation-free: constructIfEnough increments builtItemsWithIncreasingCost after the success/failure branch. No universal refund/zero-mutation guarantee is inferred.
map.yairpg_implication: Existing Eda research understanding enables constructing the real jig; held jig/offcuts/bench/body produce sound staves, and two staves/resin/effort produce actual kits. Destination view should expose whichever real gate is currently missing.

map.system_join: new research -> obsolete planned production -> qualified work carryover
map.mechanism: Swordsman data names Steel as obsoleteTech and Longswordsman as upgradesTo. Those fields feed automatic in-production queue replacement. Already invested production transfers only when obsolescence is the sole rejection and a buildable upgrade exists; otherwise removed invalid unit work is not universally refunded. This source path affects production queues, not already fielded units.
map.yairpg_implication: Original larger proposal: new methods can change useful future work without erasing completed learning or pretending accepted reservations automatically convert. In this finite trial, preserve accepted ordinary job and let player cancel/reconsider only unreserved tail; no automatic recipe migration selected.

map.system_join: culture economy -> exclusive institution -> conditional future yield
map.mechanism: Turn culture funds adoption; normal picker checks era/prerequisites/exclusions/cost. Rationalism foregoes Piety and contributes conditional science, not an always-on reward. Happiness <0 suppresses the multiplier without restoring spent culture or reopening Piety through normal adoption.
map.yairpg_implication: Retain earned branch and actual physical consumer separately from temporary body/source/site support. YAIRPG already has this division; an institute must not replace it with a generic global reputation/happiness meter.

map.system_join: base ruleset -> named expansion reach -> evidence boundary
map.mechanism: Core manager code is shared, but concrete prerequisite/cost/policy/unit data inspected here comes from G&K. Vanilla enum presence is inventory only; BNW mods and licensed DLC are outside this semantic audit. README roadmap does not establish exhaustive feature absence or DLC parity.
map.yairpg_implication: Treat future ruleset/world variants as source-qualified definitions with compatible owner contracts, not guaranteed adaptations from a label.
